user.title: Connect to Guesty
user.description: Create credentials in Guesty under Integrations > API & Webhooks. Credentials remain in Home Assistant and are never sent to the display.

error.invalid_auth: The Client ID or Client secret is invalid.

abort.already_configured: This Guesty application is already configured.

menu_options.mapping: Assign a listing to a display

mapping.title: Select display mapping
mapping.description: Choose the display whose listing and welcome text you want to edit.

mapping_details.title: Edit display mapping
mapping_details.description: Existing settings are loaded from the selected display mapping.

data_description.welcome_title: Available variables: first_name, property_name, check_in, check_out
data_description.welcome_text: Line breaks are preserved on the display.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Shows the current weather symbol and rounded outdoor temperature from this Home Assistant weather entity in the top-right corner.

general.title: General settings
general.description: These settings apply to every display. Global logo: {logo_status}. Uploading a new file replaces the existing logo.

data_description.logo_upload: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB. The logo is automatically scaled without a border and optimized for four grayscale levels.

firmware.title: Create E1001 firmware
firmware.description: Creates a secure ESPHome configuration under /config/esphome. Automatic mode sleeps on battery and stays online on USB power. The status and charging LEDs, buzzer, and microphone are disabled.

data_description.firmware_device_name: 1-24 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Unique for every display.
data_description.firmware_power_mode: Automatic is recommended for the E1001.
data_description.firmware_awake_seconds: The display sleeps earlier as soon as Home Assistant has delivered new data.

error.invalid_logo: The logo could not be processed. Use a visible PNG or JPEG file up to 5 MB.
error.firmware_file_exists: An ESPHome file already uses this device name. Enable replacement only for a file previously created by GuestyTerminal; other files are never overwritten.
error.firmware_write_failed: The ESPHome configuration could not be written. Verify that /config/esphome is available.

abort.no_displays: No compatible ESPHome display was found. Flash the supplied E1001 package and wake the display first.
abort.firmware_created: The configuration was created at {path}. Open ESPHome Device Builder, select {device_name}, then choose Install. USB is recommended for the first installation.

firmware_no_managed_configs.message: No GuestyTerminal-managed ESPHome configurations were found. Create the display firmware through GuestyTerminal setup first.

firmware_config_update_failed.message: The managed ESPHome configurations could not be updated safely.

firmware_builder_unavailable.message: ESPHome Device Builder is unavailable or not connected to Home Assistant.

firmware_builder_auth_required.message: ESPHome Device Builder requires separate authentication. Use the Device Builder connected to Home Assistant without additional credentials.

firmware_builder_too_old.message: ESPHome Device Builder does not support bulk updates yet. Update it to version 2026.7 or later.

firmware_builder_invalid_response.message: ESPHome Device Builder returned an unexpected response to the bulk request.

firmware_queue_failed.message: ESPHome Device Builder could not create the firmware jobs.

firmware_update_in_progress.message: A display firmware bulk update is already being prepared.
